sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a lamp crafted from volcanic stone and informed by a sunrise is among the projects from Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey. Also featured is a stone plate with a glass cloche referencing Mexican cinema, and a wooden stool featuring leather tassels. Tecnológico de Monterrey School: Architecture, Art and Design The post Table lamp made from volcanic stone among projects from Tecnológico de Monterrey appeared first on Dezeen .
